entities.name: Query PNPase A2C794
observations: The 721-aa query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt A2C794, a polyribonucleotide nucleotidyltransferase from Prochlorococcus marinus MIT 9303.
Annotated function: processive 3′-to-5′ phosphorolysis of single-stranded polyribonucleotides during mRNA degradation; EC 2.7.7.8.
Annotated cofactor: Mg2+; annotated localization: cytoplasm.
Sequence-derived estimates: 77,897 Da molecular mass and pI 5.49.
